name: tia_rename_plc_type
description: Rename one PLC data type (UDT) in place (no delete, re-import or overwrite) and verify by read-back. Fails without changes when any UDT or program block in the PLC already uses the new name (case-insensitive). Importing a UDT under a new name creates a second type instead; use this tool to rename. Only the PLC software's own folders are searched; objects inside S7-1500 software units are out of scope.

type_name.description: Exact current name of the PLC data type (UDT).

new_name.description: New name; no leading/trailing whitespace, control characters or path separators.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

group_path.description: Exact type-folder path of the type. Omit to search all folders; an empty string means the root folder only.

on_conflict.description: Conflict policy; only 'fail' is supported, existing names are never overwritten.
